variants.headline: Looking back: government cannot pay its debts
variants.sub: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts.

The gazette records the government's inability to pay without specifying an unreported sum or creditor arrangement. Default and the measures taken in response are separate administrative facts. Public understanding requires care not to turn a financial condition into notice of a policy decision that has not been established.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The stewardship of {target} requires scrutiny against the inability to pay. This paper does not presume the origin of the debts or announce a response that the financial report has not established.
